subtitle: Out Manila · Philippine Airlines
overview: Fly direct to Shanghai and start at Xinshi Ancient Town with a Hanfu experience and imperial-style banquet, staying in a local 5-star Holiday Inn. Then see the Bund, Oriental Pearl Tower and Nanjing Road, with a free day on Day 3 for the optional Shanghai Disneyland.
travelDatesNote: Departures from Manila, Dec 11–14 2026 to Dec 11–14 2026. The rate changes by date: an amount on a date is added to the base rate per pax. Seats are limited and confirmed at booking.

placeDesc.Xinshi Ancient Town: An ancient water town in Zhejiang with a hanfu experience, imperial-style dinner and night view.
placeDesc.The Bund: Shanghai's riverfront promenade with historic buildings facing the Pudong skyline.
placeDesc.Oriental Pearl Tower: A TV tower in Pudong with its distinctive spheres, seen from outside on this tour.
placeDesc.Nanjing Road: Shanghai's main pedestrian shopping street, lined with stores and neon lights.
placeDesc.Chenghuang Temple Market: A traditional market area around the City God Temple in old Shanghai.
placeDesc.Jade Craft Exhibition Center: An exhibition centre for jade craft, a shopping stop on the last morning.
placeDesc.The Louis (LV mega ship): A large Louis Vuitton boat-shaped building on the Shanghai waterfront, a photo stop.
placeDesc.Shanghai Disneyland: A full-day theme park outing offered as an optional tour on the free day, USD 120 per person.
placeDesc.Huangpu River: The river through Shanghai; the optional cruise shows the city's night skyline.
